🏆 OpenTV v2.4.3 (Build 50) - Comprehensive QA & Production Polish:
• Verified 100% Zero-Error Architecture: Comprehensive automated browser and remote control audit passed with 0 runtime exceptions
• TV Series Modal Remote Back Fix: TV remote Back key now properly closes Series Details modal and returns focus to the series card
• D-Pad Focus Restoration: When closing Movie or Series modals, remote focus instantly returns to the previously highlighted card
• Backdrop Click-to-Close: Clicking anywhere outside dialog cards now closes modals cleanly
• Cleaned Legacy Stubs: Purged dead quick-guide references for a pristine JavaScript runtime
• Full Dolby AC3 / EAC3 5.1 External Player Bridge & Cable-TV Channel Zap HUD intact
